title: CausalChaos! Dataset for Comprehensive Causal Action Question Answering Over Longer Causal Chains Grounded in Dynamic Visual Scenes

bias_targets.methodology: The authors evaluate frequency-based biases (or shortcut biases) by introducing a 'Causal-Confusion' test set. In this test set, hard negative incorrect options contain the exact same objects and actors as the correct answers, but with altered or reversed causal relationships. This tests whether models rely on simple object/action word-matching correlations from their training data (e.g., associating a 'Lion' with 'killing') rather than performing true causal reasoning.
